critical_code_review_comments: book/[id].tsx now correctly uses useFocusEffect(useCallback(load,[load])) — will refetch on every screen focus so newly-added addresses from /addresses appear without app restart.
Preselection logic prefers the previously-selected address (if still valid) → is_default → first address — robust to list re-orderings.
'DEFAULT' pill and dashed '+ Add or manage addresses' pressable render only when addresses.length>0; the empty '+ Add Address' placeholder renders only when length===0 — correct branching.

assets/brand/smartfix-logo.png (~720KB) is used via expo-image with contentFit='contain'; consider providing a smaller optimized variant (already have smartfix-logo.webp ~245KB) to reduce bundle size — non-blocking.

addresses.tsx form initial state has is_default:true which means every new address created from the form becomes the new default (backend unsets prior default). This is the observed behavior during testing; if product wants only the FIRST address to auto-default, change initial to false. Not a bug per current spec.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: Confirm-Booking screen always displayed '+ Add Address' empty placeholder even when customer had saved addresses. Root cause: book/[id].tsx used useEffect (loaded addresses once on mount) and did not preselect a default. Fix (already applied by main agent): switched to useFocusEffect so returning to the screen refetches; added preselection logic (previous → is_default → first); rendered a 'DEFAULT' pill and dashed '+ Add or manage addresses' CTA. Verified end-to-end on mobile web preview.
